messages:
Priya (AE): Quick ask — inbound from client "Luminar Insights". They want a one-time promotional waiver: 40% off first invoice + extended net75 for 60-day pilot.
Ethan (DealDesk): 40% is well above standard. Need ARR and exposure calc.
Priya (AE): If they convert, ARR ~$95k. Pilot list spend ~18k. With 40% off first invoice, revenue impact = ~7.2k immediate.
Maya (Finance Ops): Finance policy: any concession >30% requires CFO signoff. Net75 unacceptable; max net60 can be considered with AR collateral (PO + payment guarantee).
Ethan (DealDesk): Could we structure as 30% off + $4k usage credit instead of 40%+net75?
Priya (AE): Client prefers big upfront discount to preserve cashflow. They can provide a parent company guarantee.
Carlos (Legal): Parent guarantee helps; need guarantee language and corporate resolution. Clawback language mandatory for extended payment terms.
Jane (CFO): I will approve up to 30% one-time credit if we get parent guarantee and PO before pilot start. Net75 only with CFO explicit approval and a signed guarantee + escrow of first month equivalent.
Priya (AE): I'll request guarantee docs and PO.
Maya (Finance Ops): BillingBot: flag account LUMINAR-77 for guarantee review and set billing hold until docs cleared.
BillingBot: Account LUMINAR-77 flagged. HOLD_REASON: GUARANTEE_PENDING.
Ethan (DealDesk): Final proposal: 30% one-time credit on first invoice + $4k usage credit during pilot. Net60 upon receipt of guarantee; net75 not acceptable without escrow.
Jane (CFO): Approved with conditions above. Forward guarantee docs to Legal and AR.
Priya (AE): Copy — will follow up. Closing thread and routing to ops. :rocket:
